name: OWASP MASWE (Mobile Application Security Weakness Enumeration)
source_notes: Titles and masvs-v2 mappings verified from a clone of OWASP/maswe (weaknesses/, last commit 2026-09-30); MASTG test links from OWASP/mastg tests-beta/ios front matter.
caveats: Only MASWE entries present in the notes are included (65 entries); MASWE-0051..0060, 0062, 0064 and 0065 (RESILIENCE) were not captured and are omitted.
MASWE-0037 title is truncated in the notes ("…via Notifications"); name is null and name_partial holds the fragment.

related masvs-2.1 links come from MASWE masvs-v2 front matter where the notes recorded them; entries without a recorded mapping have none (only their masvs_group, taken from the repo folder, is known).
CWE lists are only populated where the notes recorded them (MASWE-0005); other entries have CWE mappings in front matter that were not captured.
Mobile Top 10 2024 links are inferred; OWASP publishes no MASWE-to-Top-10 mapping.
MASTG-TEST-0276 front matter points to MASWE-0036 although MASWE-0030 is the clipboard weakness; mastg_tests follows the front matter.
status 'released' and edition null: MASWE has no versioned release in the notes; this is a snapshot of the main branch. Maturity 'flagship' is inherited from the OWASP MAS project.
Summaries are title paraphrases; prevention is [] (not captured).
detection.static entries are reinhardt rule ideas mapped from MASTG tests and RN/Expo docs.

items.name: Sensitive Data Stored Unencrypted in Private Storage
items.summary: Weakness: Sensitive Data Stored Unencrypted in Private Storage.

static: UserDefaults.standard.set(...) or @AppStorage("...token|password|secret|apiKey...") holding secrets instead of Keychain
FileManager / POSIX I/O / Core Data / SQLite writes of sensitive data without encryption
React Native AsyncStorage.setItem(...) with token/secret-like keys (AsyncStorage is unencrypted)

items.name: Sensitive Data Stored Unencrypted Outside of Private Storage
items.summary: Weakness: Sensitive Data Stored Unencrypted Outside of Private Storage.

static: Sensitive data written to shared storage or shared App Group containers without encryption

items.name: Cryptographic Keys Stored Outside of Platform Keystore
items.summary: Weakness: Cryptographic Keys Stored Outside of Platform Keystore.

static: Raw key literals passed to SecKeyCreateWithData, CCCrypt key parameter, or CryptoKit init(rawRepresentation:) (e.g. P256.Signing.PrivateKey)

items.name: Sensitive Data Hardcoded in the App Package
items.summary: Weakness: Sensitive Data Hardcoded in the App Package.

static: API keys or secret literals in Swift string constants or Info.plist
EXPO_PUBLIC_* variable names containing SECRET, PRIVATE, SERVICE_ROLE or a non-publishable KEY

items.name: Insertion of Sensitive Data into Logs
items.summary: The app should keep sensitive data out of application logs.

static: print / NSLog / NSAssert / NSCAssert / printf / os_log / Logger calls with token-, password- or PII-like values

items.name: Sensitive Data Not Excluded From Backup
items.summary: Weakness: Sensitive Data Not Excluded From Backup.

static: Files holding sensitive data not marked for backup exclusion

items.name: Network Traffic Not Encrypted
items.summary: Weakness: Network Traffic Not Encrypted.

static: Info.plist NSAppTransportSecurity keys allowing cleartext: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads, NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsInWebContent, NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsForMedia, NSExceptionAllowsInsecureHTTPLoads
Weak ATS exceptions: NSExceptionMinimumTLSVersion below TLSv1.2, NSExceptionRequiresForwardSecrecy = false, broad NSIncludesSubdomains = true
Hardcoded http:// URLs used for communication (excluding localhost and XML namespace URIs)

items.name: Insecure Certificate Validation
items.summary: Weakness: Insecure Certificate Validation.

static: urlSession(_:didReceive:completionHandler:) / urlSession(_:task:didReceive:completionHandler:) calling completionHandler(.useCredential, URLCredential(trust: serverTrust)) without SecTrustEvaluateWithError
WKNavigationDelegate authentication-challenge handlers that accept any server trust

items.name: Insecure Deep Links

Custom URL scheme handlers performing sensitive operations without checking UIOpenURLContext.options.sourceApplication
